key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by modeling the full reasoning process, not just the problem stem, to better capture knowledge, difficulty, and competency signals.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable data-driven framework for educational AI systems that need reliable automatic filtering and evaluation of generated math items.
method: Builds process-enhanced item data by converting raw solutions into structured reasoning trees.
Uses Large Language Models to generate hierarchical reasoning trees and Graph Neural Networks to encode their topology and procedural semantics.
Fuses stem semantics with solving-process representations in a dual-view "Stem + Solving" architecture.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on K12 math datasets, showing the method effectively captures process-oriented features for fine-grained quality assessment.
watch_item: The approach depends on high-quality solution traces and LLM-generated reasoning trees, which may introduce noise or extra cost in real deployment.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
